summary: Huachen AI Parking Management Technology Holding Co., Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten best-efforts public offering of up to 2,750,000 Class A ordinary shares and accompanying ordinary warrants priced at US$1.00 per unit, with each warrant exercisable at $1.00 and expiring three years after issuance. The offering is a routine capital raise under an effective shelf, not a special situation. The last reported share price was US$1.855 on September 14, 2026, implying a discount to market. The company is a Cayman holding company operating in China. What to watch is the potential dilution from share and warrant overhang.
